editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inversions, no dropped caveats, no hallucinated clauses; the negation in "لا تحل مدونة السلوك هذه محل سياسات IBM المؤسسية الحالية" and the conditional chain in step 2 ("إذا لم يتوقف الشخص فوراً... أو لم يصحح المشكلة") both track the English exactly, and the informal singular register (أخبر الشخص، إذا كنت مرتاحاً، محيطك) holds consistently. What a native technical editor would still change: "sexist" is rendered as "الجنسية" ("sexual") in the bullet "التعليقات والنكات العنصرية أو الجنسية أو الطبقية" — it should be "المتحيزة جنسياً"; "Doxxing" becomes "التشهير الإلكتروني" (defamation), which names a different act than publishing someone's private data, though the following clause recovers it; and "advances" collapses into "التحرش", the same word already used for "harassment" two bullets later. There is also a calque cluster in the enforcement paragraph — "commits" → "الالتزامات البرمجية" and "issues" → "القضايا" (legal-case sense) — and "enforcement" splits between "الإنفاذ" (heading and body) and "تنفيذ" in "مجلس تنفيذ مدونة السلوك". None of these would make a reader form a false belief about the policy.

examples.source: Pointing out unintentionally racist, sexist, casteist, or biased comments and jokes made by community members when they happen
examples.suggested: الإشارة إلى التعليقات والنكات العنصرية أو المتحيزة جنسياً أو الطبقية أو المنحازة غير المقصودة...
examples.translation: الإشارة إلى التعليقات والنكات العنصرية أو الجنسية أو الطبقية أو المتحيزة غير المقصودة من أعضاء المجتمع عند حدوثها
examples.why: "الجنسية" reads as "sexual", not "sexist"; it names a content category rather than a discrimination category. Recoverable from the surrounding list (عنصرية/طبقية), so imperfect rather than misleading.

examples.source: "Doxxing," Publishing screenshots or quotes, especially from identity slack channels...
examples.suggested: "الدوكسينغ" (نشر البيانات الشخصية)، نشر لقطات شاشة أو اقتباسات...
examples.translation: "التشهير الإلكتروني"، نشر لقطات شاشة أو اقتباسات، خاصة من قنوات الهوية في Slack...
examples.why: التشهير means defamation/public shaming, a different offence from publishing identifying material without consent. The explanatory clause that follows keeps the rule clear, so the slip is at term level only.

examples.source: unwelcome physical contact, sexual attention, or advances
examples.suggested: ...أو الاهتمام الجنسي أو المراودة
examples.translation: الاتصال الجسدي غير المرغوب فيه أو الاهتمام الجنسي أو التحرش
examples.why: "advances" is rendered with التحرش, the same word used for "harassment" in the next bullet (التحرش العام أو الخاض) and in "خالية من التحرش", so two distinct English categories collapse into one Arabic term.

examples.source: remove, edit, or reject comments, commits, code, wiki edits, issues, and other contributions
examples.suggested: ...التعليقات والـ commits وتعديلات الويكي والمشكلات (issues) والمساهمات الأخرى
examples.translation: إزالة أو تعديل أو رفض التعليقات والالتزامات البرمجية والكود وتعديلات الويكي والقضايا والمساهمات الأخرى
examples.why: "الالتزامات البرمجية" for commits and "القضايا" (legal-case sense) for issues are calques no Arabic-speaking developer would write for Git/GitHub objects.

examples.source: Code of Conduct enforcement board / Responsibilities and enforcement
examples.suggested: مجلس إنفاذ مدونة السلوك
examples.translation: مجلس تنفيذ مدونة السلوك / المسؤوليات والإنفاذ
examples.why: "enforcement" is الإنفاذ in the heading and body but تنفيذ (implementation/execution) in the board's name — within-file inconsistency for the same concept.

editor_note: No misleading content: the transpilation definition, the ISA paragraph, the six-stage list and the optimization_level 0–3 sentence all track the English faithfully, and the orchestra analogy (المايسترو / أقسام الآلات / العازفين الأفراد) survives intact. What a native technical editor would change: (1) "unrolling custom instructions" is rendered "فك تسجيل التعليمات المخصصة", which reads as "de-registering" rather than expanding/decomposing custom instructions — the standard rendering is "فك/توسيع التعليمات المخصصة"; (2) the sentence "Which passes are chained together and in which order has a major effect" is flattened to "ترتيب الـ passes وتسلسلها" — only the ordering survives, the selection of *which* passes is dropped (and the two nouns are near-synonymous, so the clause reads redundant); (3) the six stages are labelled inconsistently — `init`, `translation`, `optimization`, `scheduling` become "هذه المرحلة" while `layout` and `routing` become "هذا الـ Pass", although the English says "This pass" for all but `scheduling`. Also several agreement slips ("تتكون خط أنابيب" → يتكون, "حتى تُستوفى شرط معين" → يُستوفى, "قبل أن تتم تضمين الدائرة" → يتم), and "utility-scale work" softened to the generic "أعمال على نطاق واسع". Register is correctly informal throughout (كنت تستخدم، دائرتك، فكّر).

examples.source: This typically involves unrolling custom instructions and converting the circuit to all single- and two-qubit gates.
examples.suggested: يتضمن ذلك عادةً فك (توسيع) التعليمات المخصصة وتحويل الدائرة إلى بوابات أحادية وثنائية القبيت.
examples.translation: يتضمن ذلك عادةً فك تسجيل التعليمات المخصصة وتحويل الدائرة إلى بوابات أحادية وثنائية القبيت.
examples.why: "فك تسجيل" reads as "de-registering", an operation the transpiler does not perform; unrolling here means expanding a custom instruction into its constituent basis gates.

examples.source: Which passes are chained together and in which order has a major effect on the final outcome.
examples.suggested: إن اختيار الـ passes التي تُدمج معًا وترتيب تنفيذها يؤثر تأثيرًا كبيرًا على النتيجة النهائية.
examples.translation: ترتيب الـ passes وتسلسلها يؤثر تأثيرًا كبيرًا على النتيجة النهائية.
examples.why: The English makes two claims — which passes you chain AND in what order; the Arabic keeps only ordering (stated twice as ترتيب/تسلسل), dropping the selection half of the point.

examples.source: 1. `init` - This pass runs any initial passes … 2. `layout` - This pass applies a layout …
examples.suggested: Use one label for all six list items (e.g. "يُشغّل هذا الـ Pass" throughout, matching the English "This pass").
examples.translation: `init` - تُشغّل هذه المرحلة … / `layout` - يُطبّق هذا الـ Pass …
examples.why: Within one list the same referent alternates between "مرحلة" and "الـ Pass", so the reader cannot tell whether stage and pass are being distinguished deliberately.

examples.source: then execute its `run` method with your circuit as input
examples.suggested: ثم استدعاء التابع `run` الخاص به مع دائرتك كمُدخَل
examples.translation: ثم تنفيذ الـ method الخاصة بـ `run` مع دائرتك كمُدخَل
examples.why: The genitive is inverted — the Arabic says "the method belonging to run" instead of "the run method of the pass manager"; a native writer would say استدعاء التابع `run`.

editor_note: Meaning is fully faithful throughout — the plan list with its "(باستثناء حسابات التجربة المجانية)" carve-out, the Cloud Case vs Technical Issue branch, the negation in "لن *يُفرض على المستخدم أي رسوم*", the hedge "ستفقد الوصول على الأرجح", and the owner-vs-invited billing distinction all match the English, and the informal singular register (تواجهها/حسابك/فاختر) holds. Two surface slips a native technical editor would still change: the H2 "احصل على المساعدة مع IBM Quantum Platform وQiskit" calques English "help with" — Arabic idiom wants "في"/"بشأن", not "مع"; and in the Create-Case bullet "فاختر Account (…) كالفئة، ثم Account verification كموضوع فرعي" the definite "كالفئة" reads as "like the category" and breaks parallelism with the indefinite "كموضوع فرعي" (كفئة / بوصفها الفئة). Neither misleads the reader; the UI strings and links are intact.

examples.source: ## Get help with IBM Quantum Platform and Qiskit
examples.suggested: ## الحصول على المساعدة بشأن IBM Quantum Platform وQiskit
examples.translation: ## احصل على المساعدة مع IBM Quantum Platform وQiskit
examples.why: "المساعدة مع X" is a direct calque of English "help with"; Arabic technical writing uses "المساعدة في/بشأن". Heading style also normally prefers the masdar (الحصول على) over the imperative here.

examples.source: choose Account (Managing your account and resources) as the category, followed by Account verification as the Subtopic
examples.suggested: فاختر Account (Managing your account and resources) بوصفها الفئة، ثم Account verification بوصفها الموضوع الفرعي
examples.translation: فاختر Account (Managing your account and resources) كالفئة، ثم Account verification كموضوع فرعي
examples.why: "كالفئة" with the definite article reads as "like the category" rather than "as the category", and it is not parallel with the indefinite "كموضوع فرعي" in the same sentence.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, no swapped quantities, no dropped caveats; the ~50-qubit ceiling, the 15 May 2024 retirement date, the "local testing mode has no built-in error suppression or mitigation" note, and the Open Plan sessions caution all survive intact, and the informal "tú" register holds consistently (puedes, especifica, Usa, consulta). Two things a native technical editor would still change. (1) `primitive` is rendered as the masculine "un primitivo" / "primitivos de Qiskit Aer"; the established Spanish Qiskit convention is the feminine "una primitiva" / "las primitivas de Qiskit Aer" — recognizable, but the wrong gender/noun for the domain term, used consistently in both occurrences. (2) The translation repeatedly adds an unsourced qualifier "real" to bare "hardware": EN "Exploring quantum computers of 100 qubits and more requires hardware" becomes "requiere hardware real", and the opening "the choice between using simulators and quantum hardware" becomes "entre usar simuladores y hardware cuántico real" — harmless in context but an added emphasis the English does not carry.

examples.source: ...when instantiating a primitive or a session. / ...with Qiskit Aer primitives
examples.suggested: ...al instanciar una primitiva o una sesión. / ...con las primitivas de Qiskit Aer
examples.translation: ...al instanciar un primitivo o una sesión. / ...con primitivos de Qiskit Aer
examples.why: The Qiskit domain term is feminine in Spanish ('las primitivas Sampler y Estimator'); 'un primitivo' reads as the generic adjective/noun rather than the API concept. Consistent within the file, so recognizable — MINOR, not misleading.

examples.source: Exploring quantum computers of 100 qubits and more requires hardware.
examples.suggested: Explorar computadoras cuánticas de 100 qubits o más requiere hardware.
examples.translation: Explorar computadoras cuánticas de 100 qubits o más requiere hardware real.
examples.why: 'real' is added where the English says only 'hardware'. The contrast with simulators makes it unambiguous, so no learner is misled, but it is an inserted qualifier; the same insertion recurs in the opening paragraph ('hardware cuántico real').

editor_note: Semantically faithful throughout — no drift, no hallucination, no dropped caveat; the load-bearing passages (`exclusive=true`/`exclusive=false` execution-lane semantics, "Slurm tiene acceso completo al backend" and its three implications, "no hay acceso cuántico compartido a nivel de clúster") all match the English exactly, and the informal "tú" register holds consistently ("Ten en cuenta", "Lee", "añade", "Consulta"). The remaining defects are cosmetic calques a native technical editor would still change: the heading "Especificidades del backend" for "Backend specifics" (native Spanish HPC docs write "Detalles específicos del backend"); "multi-tenencia" with an English-style hyphen instead of "multitenencia"/"multiinquilino"; and the product name "Quantum Resource Management Interface (QRMI)" fully translated to "Interfaz de Gestión de Recursos Cuánticos (QRMI)", which leaves the retained acronym unexplained. None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: ### Backend specifics
examples.suggested: ### Detalles específicos del backend
examples.translation: ### Especificidades del backend
examples.why: "Especificidades" is a literal calque of "specifics"; Spanish technical documentation uses "detalles específicos de…" for this kind of per-vendor section heading. Non-misleading, purely stylistic.

examples.source: The Slurm plugin is responsible for multi-tenancy (ensuring that users don't see results of other users' jobs)
examples.suggested: El plugin de Slurm es responsable de la multitenencia (garantizar que los usuarios no vean los resultados de los trabajos de otros usuarios)
examples.translation: El plugin de Slurm es responsable de la multi-tenencia (garantizar que los usuarios no vean los resultados de los trabajos de otros usuarios)
examples.why: The hyphen in "multi-tenencia" reproduces English orthography; Spanish prefixes are written solid ("multitenencia", or "multiinquilino"). The concept remains fully identifiable, so this is a spelling/register slip only.

examples.source: the [Quantum Resource Management Interface (QRMI)](/guides/qrmi)
examples.suggested: la [Quantum Resource Management Interface (QRMI)](/guides/qrmi) (interfaz de gestión de recursos cuánticos)
examples.translation: la [Interfaz de Gestión de Recursos Cuánticos (QRMI)](/guides/qrmi)
examples.why: The expansion is translated while the acronym stays English, so the reader cannot see where QRMI comes from; naming the interface in English with a gloss preserves the link between name and acronym. Defensible as-is, hence minor.

editor_note: Prose is faithful, natural and consistently informal ("puedes ejecutar cargas de trabajo", "Consulta más información", "visita la documentación"); core terms are correct and stable throughout (gates→"puertas", transpiler→"transpilador"/"transpilación", primitives→"primitivas", observables→"observables de entrada", noise models→"modelos de ruido"), and no semantic inversion, swapped quantity or dropped caveat appears — the "más de 1.000 pruebas", the O(1)-steps mthree description and the "no son parte de Qiskit en sí" caveat all survive intact. Two things a native technical editor would still change. (1) The frontmatter description renders "the Qiskit stack" as "el ecosistema de Qiskit", collapsing a distinction the page itself draws explicitly — the body states that the ecosystem projects "no forman parte de Qiskit en sí", so the blurb promises an intro to the ecosystem when the document is an intro to the Qiskit stack; "la pila/el stack de Qiskit" is the right rendering. (2) "The benchmarking suite used for these tests" becomes "El conjunto de benchmarking utilizado para estas pruebas", which reads as a calque and is slightly odd next to "pruebas" in the same sentence; "el conjunto de pruebas de benchmarking" or "la suite de benchmarking" is what a Spanish-speaking engineer would write.

examples.source: This document provides an introduction to the Qiskit stack.
examples.suggested: Este documento ofrece una introducción a la pila (stack) de Qiskit.
examples.translation: Este documento ofrece una introducción al ecosistema de Qiskit.
examples.why: "stack" and "ecosystem" are explicitly different things in this very page ("no forman parte de Qiskit en sí"); using "ecosistema" in the page description mislabels the scope of the document.

examples.source: The benchmarking suite used for these tests, named Benchpress, is now available as an open-source package.
examples.suggested: El conjunto de pruebas de benchmarking utilizado, llamado Benchpress, ya está disponible como paquete de código abierto.
examples.translation: El conjunto de benchmarking utilizado para estas pruebas, llamado Benchpress, está ahora disponible como un paquete de código abierto.
examples.why: "conjunto de benchmarking" is a calque and sits awkwardly beside "pruebas" in the same clause; a native writer would say "conjunto de pruebas de benchmarking" or "suite de benchmarking".

editor_note: No misleading content: every technical constraint in the "Limitations de Qiskit Runtime" section survives intact (32 bits ou moins, 60 bits → ~300 diffusions vs 1 bit → 2400 diffusions, "les deux premiers objets if_test sur c0 sont considérés comme une seule diffusion", "quatre bits diffusés"), the Store note correctly keeps the negation ("**ne contient pas** la valeur de creg"), and the informal "tu" register holds throughout with zero vous/votre/veuillez slips. The main editorial defect is terminology: "classical feedforward" is rendered as "retour d'information classique" (i.e. classical *feedback*, the opposite information direction) in the frontmatter description, in the intro ("_retour d'information classique_"), and in both cross-links — while the sibling page it links to is actually titled "rétroaction classique", so the link label does not match its target and the corpus elsewhere keeps "feedforward" in English. Smaller calques remain: "expectation values" → "valeurs d'espérance" (conventional FR is "valeurs moyennes"/"valeurs attendues"), "requirements" → "exigences" for package dependencies, the English-order "l'attribut primitif `BitArray`" and "l'utilitaire addon de bases de mesure [`measurement_bases` module]", plus one added emphasis ("focus area of improvement" → "axe d'amélioration **prioritaire**"). None of these would make a learner form a false belief, since the mechanism is spelled out correctly in the same sentence each time.

examples.source: classical feedforward … This process is also known as _classical feedforward_. … Review the [classical feedforward and control flow] guide.
examples.suggested: feedforward classique (or align on « rétroaction classique » as used by the target guide)
examples.translation: le retour d'information classique … Ce processus est également connu sous le nom de _retour d'information classique_. … Consulte le guide [retour d'information classique et flux de contrôle].
examples.why: « retour d'information » is French for *feedback* — the reverse information direction from feed-forward, where the mid-circuit outcome conditions later gates with no loop back. It is also cross-file inconsistent: the linked guide classical-feedforward-and-control-flow.mdx is titled « rétroaction classique », so the link label does not match the page it opens, and the rest of the FR corpus keeps « feedforward » in English (20 occurrences).

examples.source: You can use the [`BitArray`] primitive attribute to compute the expectation values of the provided observables.
examples.suggested: … pour calculer les valeurs moyennes (valeurs attendues) des observables fournis.
examples.translation: Tu peux utiliser l'attribut primitif [`BitArray`] pour calculer les valeurs d'espérance des observables fournis.
examples.why: « valeur d'espérance » is a literal calque; French quantum texts say « valeur moyenne » (or « valeur attendue ») for an observable's expectation value — « espérance » alone belongs to probability theory. The noun-order « l'attribut primitif BitArray » is also a calque of the English compound.

examples.source: Therefore, reducing the length of mid-circuit measurement is a focus area of improvement as IBM Quantum releases the new version of dynamic circuits.
examples.suggested: … est un axe d'amélioration alors qu'IBM Quantum publie la nouvelle version …
examples.translation: Par conséquent, la réduction de la durée des mesures au milieu du circuit est un axe d'amélioration prioritaire alors qu'IBM Quantum publie la nouvelle version des circuits dynamiques.
examples.why: « prioritaire » is not in the source; « a focus area of improvement » is a neutral statement of where work is happening, not a claim that it is the top priority. Mild unwarranted strengthening — not misleading, but a native editor would drop the added adjective.

examples.source: See the Measurement bases addon utility [`measurement_bases` module] for more information.
examples.suggested: Consulte le module [`measurement_bases`] de l'utilitaire addon « Bases de mesure » pour plus d'informations.
examples.translation: Consulte l'utilitaire addon de bases de mesure [`measurement_bases` module] pour plus d'informations.
examples.why: The English left-branching compound is transposed word-for-word, leaving a French noun pile with an untranslated trailing « module » that reads as machine output rather than as a sentence a French technical writer would produce.

examples.source: The code on this page was developed using the following requirements. … Use [circuit schedule visualization] to debug and optimize your dynamic circuits.
examples.suggested: … développé avec les dépendances (prérequis) suivantes. … Utilise la [visualisation de l'ordonnancement du circuit] …
examples.translation: Le code sur cette page a été développé en utilisant les exigences suivantes. … Utilise la [visualisation du programme de circuit] pour déboguer et optimiser tes circuits dynamiques.
examples.why: « exigences » is the wrong sense of *requirements* here (these are pinned package dependencies, not demands), and « programme de circuit » for *circuit schedule* invites the reading « circuit program » instead of the temporal scheduling the linked circuit-timing guide is about.

editor_note: The physics is faithful throughout — the gate glossary (NOT/Pauli X, CNOT "crée l'intrication", Toffoli "seulement lorsque les deux contrôles sont à l'état |1⟩", RZ/RX/RY, "à une phase globale … près" for the Phase gate, "pureté réduite", "distance de Hamming") is accurate and "tu" holds everywhere, so nothing here teaches a false concept. What a native editor would fix is a cluster of grammar/naturalness defects: one sentence is simply broken — "la fenêtre de sélection de la QPU par défaut au choix de ta précédente" (verbless, unparseable, for "will default to your previous choice") — plus the duplicated "les paramètres et les paramètres des portes qui le permettent" for "parameters and settings", the typo "rédémarrer", the calqued verb in "L'axe horizontal libelle les états de base computationnelle" (twice), "En contraste" for "In contrast", and the double negative "n'est pas intriqué avec aucune autre partie". Terminology has two literal-but-wrong UI renderings — "une enveloppe de ligne" for "a line wrap" and "Déclaration" for OpenQASM "Statement" (should be "Instruction") — and "job" is split within the file between "travail" (paramètres de travail, progression du travail) and "job" (les jobs du Composer, page des résultats des jobs). One clause loses the source's structure: "utile pour prédire les résultats si tu mesures chaque qubit et la valeur stockée dans son propre bit classique" makes the stored value a second object of "mesures" instead of "each qubit is measured and the value stored in its own classical bit".

examples.source: If you run the same circuit again, the QPU selection window will default to your previous choice.
examples.suggested: Si tu exécutes le même circuit à nouveau, la fenêtre de sélection de la QPU proposera par défaut ton choix précédent.
examples.translation: Si tu exécutes le même circuit à nouveau, la fenêtre de sélection de la QPU par défaut au choix de ta précédente.
examples.why: The clause has no main verb and 'au choix de ta précédente' is not French; the sentence is unparseable as written.

examples.source: To edit the parameters and settings on gates that support editing, select the gate on the graphical editor and click Edit.
examples.suggested: Pour modifier les paramètres et les réglages des portes qui le permettent, …
examples.translation: Pour modifier les paramètres et les paramètres des portes qui le permettent, sélectionne la porte dans l'éditeur graphique et clique sur Edit.
examples.why: 'parameters and settings' collapses to the same word twice, producing a nonsensical repetition a native writer would never leave.

examples.source: it is useful for predicting the outcomes if each qubit is measured and the value stored in its own classical bit.
examples.suggested: … si chaque qubit est mesuré et que la valeur est stockée dans son propre bit classique.
examples.translation: c'est utile pour prédire les résultats si tu mesures chaque qubit et la valeur stockée dans son propre bit classique.
examples.why: The English passive 'the value [is] stored' becomes a second direct object of 'tu mesures', so the reader is told to measure the stored value rather than to store the measured value.

examples.source: …and whether you want to apply a line wrap.
examples.suggested: …et si tu veux appliquer un retour à la ligne automatique.
examples.translation: …et si tu veux appliquer une enveloppe de ligne.
examples.why: 'enveloppe' is a literal rendering of the wrong sense of 'wrap'; the Export-options item becomes unrecognisable to a French user.

examples.source: Choose your job settings / filter your Workloads table by Composer jobs / view the job's progress
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering (e.g. keep 'job' throughout, as IBM Quantum does) and use it consistently.
examples.translation: Choisis tes paramètres de travail / filtrer ton tableau Workloads par les jobs du Composer / la progression du travail
examples.why: 'job' is rendered as 'travail' in four places and left as 'job' in two others within the same section, and 'paramètres de travail' also reads as 'working parameters'.

examples.source: The horizontal axis labels the computational basis states.
examples.suggested: L'axe horizontal indique (ou étiquette) les états de la base computationnelle.
examples.translation: L'axe horizontal libelle les états de base computationnelle.
examples.why: 'libeller' is not used this way in French technical prose; it is a dictionary calque of the verb 'to label', and 'base computationnelle' is left unagreed with the plural states.

editor_note: Semantically faithful throughout: the bit-significance conventions are rendered correctly and consistently (bit 0 = "bit de poids faible", bit n-1 = "bit de poids fort", "le qubit le plus en haut"/"le plus en bas", the CX (contrôle, cible) convention, and the reverse_bits caveat "Cela n'affecte que le diagramme généré et ne modifie pas le circuit"). Nothing would mislead a learner, and the informal "tu" holds everywhere. Two wordings a native technical editor would still change: "une chaîne d'états de qubits uniques" is a calque of "a string of single-qubit states" that reads as "states of unique qubits" (should be "une chaîne d'états à un qubit" / "mono-qubit"), and "l'état de base calculatoire" is an unusual rendering of "computational basis state" (conventional French is "état de la base de calcul" or "base computationnelle").

examples.source: the following cell defines a `Statevector` from a string of single-qubit states
examples.suggested: la cellule suivante définit un `Statevector` à partir d'une chaîne d'états à un qubit
examples.translation: la cellule suivante définit un `Statevector` à partir d'une chaîne d'états de qubits uniques
examples.why: "états de qubits uniques" is a word-order calque that parses as "states of unique qubits"; the standard French term for single-qubit states is "états à un qubit" (or "mono-qubit").

examples.source: the amplitude at index $x$ represents the computational basis state $|x\rangle$
examples.suggested: l'amplitude à l'index $x$ représente l'état de la base de calcul $|x\rangle$
examples.translation: l'amplitude à l'index $x$ représente l'état de base calculatoire $|x\rangle$
examples.why: "base calculatoire" is not the conventional French rendering of "computational basis"; French quantum texts use "base de calcul" or "base computationnelle". Recognizable, so not misleading, but non-standard.

editor_note: Faithful and idiomatic throughout: the intro correctly keeps the causal chain ("Il riavvio del kernel Python comporta la perdita di tutti i risultati memorizzati in memoria… puoi salvare i risultati su file"), the three-month filter and the `created_after`/`datetime.datetime` caveat are preserved exactly, "encoders from Qiskit Runtime" → "i codificatori di Qiskit Runtime" is fine, and register stays informal-tu ("puoi", "usa", "consulta").

The translation is faithful, natural and consistently informal ("puoi", "Specifica", "Consulta"), with correct domain conventions (primitiva/primitive, backend and Estimator/Sampler kept in English, "soppressione/mitigazione degli errori"). Two things a native technical editor would still change: (1) "non deve essere istanziata" renders English "does not need to be instantiated" with a modal that Italian readers most naturally parse as a prohibition ("must not be instantiated") — the idiomatic "non è necessario istanziarla" removes the ambiguity; (2) in the Defaults section the singular "the server default value is used … the default value will be the same" becomes plural then singular ("vengono utilizzati i valori predefiniti del server … il valore predefinito sarà lo stesso"), an internal number mismatch within two adjacent clauses. Neither would make a learner do the wrong thing, so this stays below FAIL.

examples.source: The primitive's options class (`EstimatorOptions` or `SamplerOptions`) does not need to be instantiated if you are setting options after initializing the primitive.
examples.suggested: ... non è necessario istanziarla se imposti le opzioni dopo aver inizializzato la primitiva.
examples.translation: La classe di opzioni della primitiva ([`EstimatorOptions`] o [`SamplerOptions`]) non deve essere istanziata se imposti le opzioni dopo aver inizializzato la primitiva.
examples.why: "non deve essere" reads primarily as an obligation-negation ("must not"), turning a permissive statement (you can skip it) into an apparent prohibition. The English only says instantiation is unnecessary.

examples.source: it is given a special value of `Unset` and the server default value is used. Thus, the default value will be the same regardless of your code version.
examples.suggested: ... e viene utilizzato il valore predefinito del server. Pertanto, il valore predefinito sarà lo stesso ...
examples.translation: le viene assegnato il valore speciale `Unset` e vengono utilizzati i valori predefiniti del server. Pertanto, il valore predefinito sarà lo stesso indipendentemente dalla versione del codice.
examples.why: The English keeps a single option in view throughout ("the server default value" → "the default value"); the Italian switches to plural and back within two clauses, blurring the per-option reference. Harmless but inconsistent.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no hallucination: tricky passages are handled correctly ("all but the smallest quantum devices and input circuits" → "per tutti i dispositivi quantistici e i circuiti di input tranne i più piccoli"; "only run if it is explicitly called for … does not run by default" → "viene eseguito solo se esplicitamente richiesto … e non viene eseguito di default"; "up to six CNOT gates" → "fino a sei gate CNOT"). Terminology is correct and consistent (transpilazione/transpilare, pass manager a stadi preconfigurato, gate a due qubit, gate base nativi, livelli di ottimizzazione) and the informal "tu" register holds (Ti consigliamo, vuoi, consulta, puoi vedere). What a native editor would change are two English-shaped calques — "i circuiti generati non sono garantiti essere identici" (routing stage) and "A un livello alto" for "At a high level" (scheduling stage) — plus a small internal wobble where EN "two steps … this first step" becomes "due fasi … questo primo passaggio". None of these mislead; they are stylistic polish only.

examples.source: The use of a stochastic method means that the circuits generated are not guaranteed to be the same over repeated runs.
examples.suggested: L'uso di un metodo stocastico implica che non è garantito che i circuiti generati siano identici tra esecuzioni ripetute.
examples.translation: L'uso di un metodo stocastico significa che i circuiti generati non sono garantiti essere identici tra esecuzioni ripetute.
examples.why: "non sono garantiti essere" is a direct calque of the English passive "are not guaranteed to be"; Italian does not use garantire in this raising construction — a native technical writer would use "non è garantito che … siano".

examples.source: At a high level, the scheduling pass can be thought of as explicitly inserting delay instructions...
examples.suggested: A grandi linee, il pass di scheduling può essere visto come l'inserimento esplicito di istruzioni di delay...
examples.translation: A un livello alto, il pass di scheduling può essere visto come l'inserimento esplicito di istruzioni di delay...
examples.why: "A un livello alto" is a word-for-word calque of "At a high level" and reads as MT in Italian, where the idiom is "a grandi linee" / "in linea generale". Meaning survives, but the register is unmistakably translated.

examples.source: Typically this involves two steps: first, try to find a "perfect" layout … There are two `Passes` typically used for this first step:
examples.suggested: In genere questo comporta due fasi: … Per questa prima fase si usano tipicamente due `Pass`:
examples.translation: In genere questo comporta due fasi: … Ci sono due `Pass` tipicamente usati per questo primo passaggio:
examples.why: The same referent ("step") is rendered first as "fasi" and then as "passaggio" two sentences later, so the back-reference is looser than in English; also "Ci sono due `Pass` tipicamente usati" mirrors the English "There are two Passes typically used" rather than the more idiomatic "si usano tipicamente due Pass".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the `NoiseLearner`/EstimatorV2 vs `NoiseLearnerV3`/Executor exclusivity note, the "two of three boxes carry `InjectNoise` with different `ref` (since they are not equivalent)" passage, and the Pauli-Lindblad generators/rates explanation all land correctly, with natural desu/masu prose and no hallucinated or dropped claims. Two terminology slips only: (1) "directed execution model" is rendered 指向性実行モデル here, while the rest of the ja corpus (including the linked target page's own title) uses 指示型実行モデル — 指向性 normally reads as "directivity", so the link text doesn't match the page it opens; (2) "layer" is split within the file between レイヤー (学習するレイヤー, レイヤーペアの深さ) and 層 (エンタングリング層, 最大層数). Neither would mislead a learner about the physics or the API.

examples.source: This new version, also part of the [directed execution model](/guides/directed-execution-model), gives you the ability to explicitly specify the layers you want to learn.
examples.suggested: この新バージョンは[指示型実行モデル](/guides/directed-execution-model)の一部でもあり、学習するレイヤーを明示的に指定できます。
examples.translation: この新バージョンは[指向性実行モデル](/guides/directed-execution-model)の一部でもあり、学習するレイヤーを明示的に指定できます。
examples.why: The rest of the ja corpus (and the linked page's own title/heading) uses 指示型実行モデル; 指向性 reads as 'directivity' and the link label no longer matches its destination.

examples.source: the layers you want to learn / each individual entangling layer / the maximum layers to learn / layer pair depth
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering for 'layer' across the file (e.g. レイヤー throughout: 学習するレイヤー / エンタングリングレイヤー / 学習する最大レイヤー数 / レイヤーペアの深さ).
examples.translation: 学習するレイヤー / エンタングリング層 / 学習する最大層数 / レイヤーペアの深さ
examples.why: Within-file split between レイヤー and 層 for the same concept; the concept stays identifiable, but a native technical editor would unify it.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, inversion or hallucination; the tricky negation in the YGate paragraph ("it is *not* a basis gate, whereas the XGate is") is correctly split into 「`XGate` は基底Gateですが、`YGate` はそうでは*ありません*」, and the a-priori/duration/error reasoning and the closing 「`YGate` オブジェクトはCircuitから除かれ、`Delay` Gateの形式で明示的なタイミング情報が含まれています」 both match the English exactly. Three editorial slips remain: (1) "gates that are not necessarily basis gates of our target" renders `target` as 「対象のバックエンド」, silently swapping the code object `target` — which this whole page mutates via `target.add_instruction` — for "the backend"; (2) 「Circuitのタイミングを確認し、…現れていることを確認します」 repeats 確認 twice in one sentence where the English uses "see … and confirm …"; (3) 「これらのパスは `.run()` でCircuit上で実行されます」 is a calque of "are run on the circuit" that a Japanese technical writer would phrase as 「`.run()` でCircuitに適用します」. None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: involves gates that are not necessarily basis gates of our target
examples.suggested: `target` の基底Gateとは限らないGateを含むため
examples.translation: 対象のバックエンドの基底Gateとは限らないGateを含むため
examples.why: The page treats `target` as a concrete object it retrieves and modifies (target.add_instruction(YGate(), ...)); replacing it with 「対象のバックエンド」 loses that referent and breaks the thread to the very next paragraph, which tells the reader to modify `target`.

examples.source: Use the visualization tool timeline_drawer to see the circuit's timing and confirm that a regularly-spaced sequence of XGate objects and YGate objects appear in the circuit.
examples.suggested: …Circuitのタイミングを可視化し、等間隔に並んだ `XGate` と `YGate` のシーケンスがCircuit内に現れていることを確認します。
examples.translation: …Circuitのタイミングを確認し、等間隔の `XGate` オブジェクトと `YGate` オブジェクトのシーケンスがCircuit内に現れていることを確認します。
examples.why: 確認 is used twice in a single sentence for two different English verbs (see / confirm); a native technical editor would vary the first to 可視化する or 見る.

examples.source: These passes are run on the circuit with .run().
examples.suggested: これらのパスは `.run()` でCircuitに適用します。
examples.translation: これらのパスは `.run()` でCircuit上で実行されます。
examples.why: 「Circuit上で実行されます」 is a word-for-word calque of "run on the circuit"; Japanese Qiskit prose says パスをCircuitに適用する, and the passive here also flattens the instructional register of the surrounding sentences.

editor_note: The content is faithful throughout — SemVer structure, the six-month/one-year support windows, the "at most two release series at a time" overlap rule, the 0.46.0-before-1.0.0 example, the QPY backward-vs-forward compatibility asymmetry, and the post-release 0.25.2.1 packaging story all match the English exactly, and register is consistent です/ます with no keigo. What a native technical editor would change is a handful of calques and one weak verb choice: "破壊的なAPI変更は…リリースのために予約されています" is a literal carry-over of "reserved for" (Japanese release docs say 〜に限定されます), "ユーザーに見える警告がアクティブに出されます" carries "actively" over as アクティブに, and "安定したインターフェースとしてはまだ考慮されていない" uses 考慮 where 見なす is the right verb for "considered". The one place meaning is slightly bent is "not considered safe to use" → "安全に使用することが推奨されない", which both reads oddly ("using safely is not recommended") and softens a safety statement into a recommendation; the following clause about the user bearing responsibility for class/safety invariants keeps the caveat intact, so it does not mislead, but it should be tightened.

examples.source: advanced-usage low-level methods that have stable interfaces but are not considered safe to use
examples.suggested: 安定したインターフェースを持つものの、安全に使用できるとは見なされない上級者向けの低レベルメソッド
examples.translation: 安定したインターフェースを持つが安全に使用することが推奨されない上級者向けの低レベルメソッド
examples.why: "not considered safe" is a statement about the method's safety status; 推奨されない downgrades it to a recommendation, and 「安全に使用することが推奨されない」 literally reads "using it safely is not recommended", which is not what the English says. The surrounding caveat about upholding invariants keeps it from misleading.

examples.source: Breaking API changes are reserved for major version releases.
examples.suggested: 破壊的なAPI変更はメジャーバージョンリリースに限定されます。
examples.translation: 破壊的なAPI変更はメジャーバージョンリリースのために予約されています。
examples.why: 「〜のために予約されています」 is a direct calque of "reserved for"; in Japanese it suggests a booking/reservation. Native release documentation uses 〜に限定される / 〜でのみ行われる.

examples.source: these APIs will be clearly documented as not being considered stable interfaces yet
examples.suggested: これらのAPIはまだ安定したインターフェースとは見なされないことが明確に文書化され
examples.translation: これらのAPIは安定したインターフェースとしてはまだ考慮されていないことが明確に文書化され
examples.why: "considered" in the sense of "regarded as" is 見なす, not 考慮する (which means "take into account"). As written it says the interfaces have not yet been taken into consideration.

examples.source: a user-visible warning will be actively emitted on any use of these unstable interfaces
examples.suggested: これらの不安定なインターフェースを使用すると、ユーザーに見える警告が必ず発行されます
examples.translation: これらの不安定なインターフェースの使用に対してユーザーに見える警告がアクティブに出されます
examples.why: アクティブに is an untranslated carry-over of "actively" and conveys nothing in Japanese; the intent is that the warning is always/actually emitted. 発行される is also the conventional verb for emitting warnings.

editor_note: No semantic drift: every quantity, caveat and claim tracks the English (32 qubits / 10.000 shots, `27 mH` vs `1 kcal/mol` ≈ `1,6 mH`, "esta demonstração usou ruído puro", the first-iteration caveat about `postselect_and_subsample()` running alone before `solve_fermion()`, and "peso de Hamming incorreto" for non-physical samples). Terminology is correct and consistent throughout — "estado fundamental", "ansatz", "transpilado", "solver de autoestado", "ocupação orbital média", "lote"/"subamostras", with shots/bitstrings/loop/Sampler kept in English as the field does — and register is consistently informal "você". The only things a native technical editor would touch are two calques: "Este exemplo ingere dados pré-gerados **em** um arquivo chamado `n2_fci.txt`" (with "ingerir" + "em", this reads as ingesting data *into* the file rather than reading it *from* the file; "carrega dados pré-gerados **de** um arquivo" would be unambiguous), and "a energia do estado fundamental é estimada **dentro de** aproximadamente `27 mH`", a literal rendering of "to within" that a Portuguese writer would phrase as "com uma precisão de aproximadamente 27 mH". Neither misleads.

examples.source: This example ingests pre-generated data in a file called `n2_fci.txt`, which contains one- and two-body electronic integrals.
examples.suggested: Este exemplo carrega dados pré-gerados de um arquivo chamado `n2_fci.txt`, que contém integrais eletrônicas de um e dois corpos.
examples.translation: Este exemplo ingere dados pré-gerados em um arquivo chamado `n2_fci.txt`, que contém integrais eletrônicas de um e dois corpos.
examples.why: "ingerir ... em um arquivo" is a calque of "ingests ... in a file" and reads directionally in Portuguese, as if the data were being written INTO n2_fci.txt rather than read from it. The following sentence disambiguates, so this is a fluency/clarity slip, not a misleading statement.

examples.source: The first plot shows that after a few iterations, the ground state energy is estimated to within approximately `27 mH`
examples.suggested: O primeiro gráfico mostra que, após algumas iterações, a energia do estado fundamental é estimada com uma precisão de aproximadamente `27 mH`
examples.translation: O primeiro gráfico mostra que, após algumas iterações, a energia do estado fundamental é estimada dentro de aproximadamente `27 mH`
examples.why: "estimada dentro de" is a word-for-word rendering of the English idiom "estimated to within"; in Portuguese "dentro de" reads as a container/time expression, so a native technical writer would use "com uma precisão de" or "com erro de até". Meaning survives, but the phrasing is translationese.

editor_note: Fiel e natural em todo o texto: o alerta de segurança ("sua chave de API ainda é armazenada localmente em texto simples e deve ser protegida") preserva integralmente a ressalva do inglês, e a terminologia é correta e consistente (API key→chave de API, bearer token→token bearer, requests→requisições, endpoints mantido em inglês), com "você" informal do início ao fim.

Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no hallucination, no dropped caveat; every paragraph including the last 40% (aritmética, ripple-carry, A=2/B=3, resultado gravado no registrador de B, `5` em 1024 disparos) matches the English exactly, and core terms (emaranhamento, parametrizados, base computacional, estimativa de amplitude, volume quântico) are correct and consistent. Three things a native technical editor would still change: "mede com qual precisão um computador quântico executa" is a calque — standard Portuguese uses "com que precisão"; "shots" is rendered as "execuções" (recognizable, but PT quantum docs conventionally keep "shots", and the same paragraph already uses "produz"/"medido" for the run semantics); and "atribuir esses parâmetros a valores reais" is ambiguous — the English "real values" means concrete/actual numeric values, whereas "valores reais" reads in Portuguese as "real numbers". Also slightly off: "sandwich ... between" rendered as "intercalam certos gates diagonais ... entre blocos" ("inserem/colocam ... entre" would be the natural verb). None of these mislead a learner.

examples.source: the "quantum volume" benchmark measures how accurately a quantum computer executes a type of random quantum circuit
examples.suggested: o benchmark de "volume quântico" mede com que precisão um computador quântico executa um tipo de circuito quântico aleatório
examples.translation: o benchmark de "volume quântico" mede com qual precisão um computador quântico executa um tipo de circuito quântico aleatório
examples.why: "com qual precisão" is a calque of English "how accurately"; in indirect questions Portuguese takes "com que precisão". A native technical writer would never write "com qual precisão".

examples.source: it outputs `5` for all `1024` shots (i.e. is measured with probability `1.0`)
examples.suggested: ele produz `5` em todos os `1024` disparos (shots) (ou seja, é medido com probabilidade `1.0`)
examples.translation: ele produz `5` em todas as `1024` execuções (ou seja, é medido com probabilidade `1.0`)
examples.why: "shots" is a term Portuguese Qiskit documentation conventionally keeps in English (or renders as "disparos"); "execuções" is understandable but blurs the distinction between running the circuit once and the shot count of a single job.

examples.source: You can also use this to assign these parameters to real values using a dictionary of the form `{ Parameter: number }`
examples.suggested: Você também pode usar isso para atribuir valores concretos a esses parâmetros usando um dicionário no formato `{ Parameter: number }`
examples.translation: Você também pode usar isso para atribuir esses parâmetros a valores reais usando um dicionário no formato `{ Parameter: number }`
examples.why: English "real values" here means actual/concrete numeric values; "valores reais" in Portuguese reads most naturally as "real numbers" (as opposed to complex), which is not the point being made. Not misleading enough to teach a false concept, but the qualifier lands wrong.

examples.source: These circuits sandwich certain diagonal gates (in the computational basis) between blocks of Hadamard gates.
examples.suggested: Esses circuitos inserem certos gates diagonais (na base computacional) entre blocos de gates de Hadamard.
examples.translation: Esses circuitos intercalam certos gates diagonais (na base computacional) entre blocos de gates de Hadamard.
examples.why: "intercalar ... entre" is an odd collocation in Portuguese (intercalar takes "com", not "entre"); the sandwiching image is better carried by "inserem/colocam ... entre". Meaning survives, but the phrasing is stiff.

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: quantities (112 qubit, 84-qubit→120 population_size vs 56-qubit→40, 0.8 * n_qubits minimum, 20 generations), the lowest-to-highest ordering of trajectories, and the SQD/noisy-baseline comparison are all faithful, and the informal register holds throughout with no po/opo. What a native technical editor would fix is a handful of grammar and word-choice slips: "para malutas ng Quadratic ... problema" (should be "malutas ANG"), "maaari kang ma-access ang mga resulta" (should be "maaari mong ma-access"), and the leftover-"accordingly" fragment "i-update ang column ng bilang ayon sa pamamagitan ng pagsasama" which parses as broken Tagalog. Two lexical choices are off-target though not misleading: "sharply concentrated" → "mabilis na nakakonsentra" (reads as "quickly", not "narrowly/tightly"), and "non-trading days" → "mga araw na hindi nagtatrabaho" (lit. "days that are not working"), which also clashes with the correct "araw ng pangangalakal" used for "trading days" two clauses later. Also "konfigurasyong nito"/"iba't ibang konfigurasyong ng" for "configurations" (should be "konfigurasyon").

examples.source: the cost distribution for our Variational Quantum Eigensolver (post-processed with SQD) approach is sharply concentrated at lower objective cost values
examples.suggested: ... ay masinsing nakakonsentra sa mas mababang mga halaga ng objective cost
examples.translation: ang cost distribution ... ay mabilis na nakakonsentra sa mas mababang mga halaga ng objective cost
examples.why: 'mabilis' means 'quickly/fast', not 'sharply/narrowly'. The point is the distribution's narrowness versus the broader noisy baseline; a temporal reading flattens the contrast the figure is teaching.

examples.source: Then, update the count column accordingly by joining counts of identical rounded values.
examples.suggested: Pagkatapos, i-update nang naaayon ang column ng bilang sa pamamagitan ng pagsasama ng mga bilang ng magkaparehong na-round na halaga.
examples.translation: Pagkatapos, i-update ang column ng bilang ayon sa pamamagitan ng pagsasama ng mga bilang ng magkaparehong mga rounded na halaga.
examples.why: 'ayon sa pamamagitan ng' is broken Tagalog — a stranded rendering of 'accordingly' colliding with 'sa pamamagitan ng'. No native writer would produce this.

examples.source: we have filled non-trading days with the closing price from the previous available date ... assets come from different markets with varying trading days
examples.suggested: pinuno namin ang mga araw na walang pangangalakal ng closing price ...
examples.translation: pinuno namin ang mga araw na hindi nagtatrabaho ng closing price ... may magkakaibang araw ng pangangalakal
examples.why: 'araw na hindi nagtatrabaho' literally means days when someone is not working, not market non-trading days; it is also inconsistent with 'araw ng pangangalakal' used for 'trading days' in the very next clause of the same sentence.

examples.source: to solve a QUBO problem / you can access the results of all the sampled strategies
examples.suggested: para malutas ANG QUBO na problema / maaari MONG ma-access ang mga resulta ...
examples.translation: para malutas ng Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) na problema / maaari kang ma-access ang mga resulta ng lahat ng mga na-sample na estratehiya
examples.why: Two focus/case errors: 'malutas ng' should take 'ang' with the patient-focus verb, and 'maaari kang ma-access' mismatches the ma- patient-focus verb with an actor pronoun ('maaari mong').

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: every PUB rule, array shape (5x1, 1x6/4x1→4x6, 3x6 + two 3x1), the "at most four/three values" counts, the commuting-observables caveat, and the 20-PUB/20-PubResult example all match the English exactly, and register stays informal throughout. What a native editor would change is lexical: "aggregate" is rendered as "nag-aahon ng mga elemento" (line ~135), which is not a Tagalog verb for aggregating — "pinagsasama-sama" is meant; and "left-most / right-most axis" comes out as "kaliwang pinaka-axis" / "kanang pinaka-axis" (line ~364), a broken superlative, even though the same page correctly writes "pinaka-kanang dimensyon" a few paragraphs earlier (line ~143). Two core terms are split within the file: "expectation value" is "inaasahang halaga" in the Estimator PUB section but left as English "expectation value" under "Output ng Estimator" (line ~312), and "method" alternates between "pamamaraan" (line ~39) and "method" (lines ~35, 418, 468). Smaller slips: "to bind the circuit against $\theta_k$" is calqued as "i-bind ang circuit laban sa" (adversarial "laban"), and "using the same measurement" becomes "gamit ang parehong sukat" ("same size/measure") where the very next sentence correctly uses "pagsukat".

examples.source: The PUBs aggregate elements from multiple arrays (observables and parameter values) by following the same broadcasting rules as NumPy.
examples.suggested: Ang mga PUB ay pinagsasama-sama ang mga elemento mula sa maraming array ...
examples.translation: Ang mga PUB ay nag-aahon ng mga elemento mula sa maraming array (mga observable at mga halaga ng parameter) sa pamamagitan ng pagsunod sa parehong mga patakaran sa broadcasting ng NumPy.
examples.why: 'nag-aahon' (from 'ahon', to haul up / come ashore) is not a word for aggregating; a native technical writer would write 'pinagsasama-sama' or 'tinitipon'. Meaning is still recoverable from context, so this is a lexical/naturalness slip rather than a misleading claim.

examples.source: The left-most axis of this array runs over ordered shots, while the right-most axis runs over bytes.
examples.suggested: Ang pinakakaliwang axis ng array na ito ay tumutugma sa mga ordered na shot, habang ang pinakakanang axis ay tumutugma sa mga byte.
examples.translation: Ang kaliwang pinaka-axis ng array na ito ay tumatakbo sa mga ordered na shot, habang ang kanang pinaka-axis ay tumatakbo sa mga byte.
examples.why: 'kaliwang pinaka-axis' misplaces the superlative prefix (reads as 'the left most-axis'); the same file already uses the correct form 'pinaka-kanang dimensyon' in the broadcasting rules, so it is also internally inconsistent.

examples.source: A list of one or more observables, which specify the expectation values to estimate ... it might contain an array of expectation values (PubResult.data.evs)
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering for the whole page (either keep 'expectation value' in English throughout, or use 'inaasahang halaga' throughout).
examples.translation: ... na nagtutukoy ng mga inaasahang halaga na tatantiyahin ... maaari itong maglaman ng isang array ng mga expectation value
examples.why: The page's central quantity is named two different ways; a learner scanning the Estimator output section may not connect 'expectation value' back to 'inaasahang halaga' introduced in the PUB definition. Concept stays identifiable, so MINOR.

examples.source: If you have two commuting observables in different PUBs but with the same circuit, they will not be estimated using the same measurement.
examples.suggested: ... hindi sila tatantiyahin gamit ang parehong pagsukat.
examples.translation: Kung mayroon kang dalawang commuting observable sa iba't ibang PUB ngunit may parehong circuit, hindi sila tatantiyahin gamit ang parehong sukat.
examples.why: 'sukat' reads as size/measure rather than the act of measuring; the very next sentence correctly uses 'pagsukat', so the term is inconsistent within the same admonition. The caveat itself is preserved intact.

examples.source: A collection of parameter values to bind the circuit against $\theta_k$
examples.suggested: Isang koleksyon ng mga halaga ng parameter na ibi-bind sa circuit para sa $\theta_k$
examples.translation: Isang koleksyon ng mga halaga ng parameter para i-bind ang circuit laban sa $\theta_k$
examples.why: 'laban sa' is the adversarial 'against' and is a direct calque of the English preposition; in Tagalog it suggests opposition rather than binding to values.

editor_note: The Map section inverts a workflow-order statement: EN "in preparation for the later execute step" becomes "bilang paghahanda para sa mas maagang execute na hakbang" ("the EARLIER execute step"), which contradicts the four-step order (Map → Optimize → Execute) that this very page teaches; the same phrase is rendered correctly as "mas huling execute na hakbang" in the Optimize section, so the file is also self-contradictory on this point. Everything else is faithful: Sampler/Estimator, ISA circuit, basis gates, coupling map, transpile ("i-transpile"), expectation value ("expectation value ng mga observable"), and post-selection are all correct and consistent, and the informal register holds throughout (no po/opo). Remaining defects are minor: "maaari ka ring gustong subukan" is a stiff calque of "you might also wish to test", and the closing sentence's "ang flexibility at kaginhawahan kung saan pinapayagan..." calques the English relative "with which" in a way no native technical writer would use. Fixing the "mas maagang" → "mas huling" wording resolves the misleading part.

examples.source: It is also worth considering at this point what the outcome of the particular algorithm will be in preparation for the later execute step
examples.suggested: ...bilang paghahanda para sa mas huling execute na hakbang
examples.translation: Kapaki-pakinabang din na isaalang-alang sa puntong ito ang magiging resulta ng partikular na algorithm bilang paghahanda para sa mas maagang execute na hakbang
examples.why: "mas maagang" = earlier; the source says "later". Execute is step 3, after Map (step 1), so the translation asserts a step order the page itself contradicts — and line 29 of the same file correctly uses "mas huling execute na hakbang" for the identical English phrase.

examples.source: At this point you might also wish to test out your circuits with a simulator
examples.suggested: Sa puntong ito, maaari mo ring subukan ang iyong mga circuit gamit ang isang simulator
examples.translation: Sa puntong ito, maaari ka ring gustong subukan ang iyong mga circuit gamit ang isang simulator
examples.why: "maaari ka ring gustong" is a word-for-word calque of "you might also wish to" and is ungainly in Tagalog; the modal "gusto" adds nothing and breaks the focus agreement a native writer would use.

examples.source: the flexibility and ease with which Qiskit patterns allow users to compose the different steps
examples.suggested: ang flexibility at dali kung paano pinapayagan ng mga Qiskit pattern ang mga user na pagsama-samahin ang iba't ibang hakbang
examples.translation: ang flexibility at kaginhawahan kung saan pinapayagan ng mga Qiskit pattern ang mga user na i-compose ang iba't ibang hakbang
examples.why: "kung saan" (= where) is a literal rendering of the English relative "with which"; it reads as machine-shaped syntax, and "kaginhawahan" (comfort/relief) is the wrong sense of "ease" here (should be "dali"/"kadalian").

editor_note: The bf-DCQO iteration-count sentence misattributes a quantity: the EN relative clause "which is on the order of approximately 100 iterations" describes VARIATIONAL algorithms, but the UK coordinates it onto the same subject ("загальна кількість необхідних ітерацій ... значно менша, ніж у варіаційних алгоритмів, і становить порядку приблизно 100 ітерацій"), so it reads as bf-DCQO itself needing ~100 iterations — directly contradicting "приблизно десяти ітерацій достатньо" earlier in the very same sentence. A learner takes away a wrong number and a self-contradictory claim about the algorithm's headline advantage. Secondary, non-misleading slips: "solver" is split between "розв'язувач" (Огляд) and "солвер" (Сценарії використання); "mapping" between "відображення 1-до-1" and "маппінгу"; "Digitizing/digitized (DQA)" is rendered as "дигіталізація / дигіталізованих квантових адіабатичних обчислень" where the field uses "дискретизація/оцифрування"; and the table header "Total Number of shots" becomes "Загальна кількість вимірювань", conflating shots with measurements. Register is otherwise consistently informal "ти" and the prose reads naturally.

examples.source: Typically, approximately ten iterations are sufficient to converge to a solution, in total requiring a much lower number of iterations than variational algorithms, which is on the order of approximately 100 iterations.
examples.suggested: Як правило, приблизно десяти ітерацій достатньо для збіжності до розв'язку — загалом значно менше ітерацій, ніж потребують варіаційні алгоритми, яким потрібно порядку 100 ітерацій.
examples.translation: Як правило, приблизно десяти ітерацій достатньо для збіжності до розв'язку, а загальна кількість необхідних ітерацій значно менша, ніж у варіаційних алгоритмів, і становить порядку приблизно 100 ітерацій.
examples.why: The ~100 figure belongs to variational algorithms in the source; the UK coordination attaches it to bf-DCQO's own iteration count, producing a self-contradictory claim (ten sufficient, yet ~100 required) and teaching the wrong number for the algorithm's key selling point.

examples.source: This solver leverages Kipu's cutting-edge bf-DCQO algorithm … Typical use cases for the Optimization solver are combinatorial optimization problems.
examples.suggested: Use "розв'язувач" in both places ("Типові сценарії використання розв'язувача оптимізації…").
examples.translation: Цей розв'язувач використовує передовий алгоритм bf-DCQO … Типові сценарії використання для солвера оптимізації — це комбінаторні задачі оптимізації.
examples.why: The same entity is named two different ways within one file (розв'язувач vs солвер); recognizable but inconsistent.

examples.source: Digitizing this evolution is the basis of digitized quantum adiabatic computation (DQA)
examples.suggested: Дискретизація (оцифрування) цієї еволюції є основою дискретизованих квантових адіабатичних обчислень (DQA)
examples.translation: Дигіталізація цієї еволюції є основою дигіталізованих квантових адіабатичних обчислень (DQA)
examples.why: "Дигіталізація" is a business-domain borrowing (digitalization); the physics sense here is time-discretization, normally "дискретизація"/"оцифрування" in Ukrainian technical writing.

examples.source: Total Number of shots
examples.suggested: Загальна кількість shots (запусків/повторень)
examples.translation: Загальна кількість вимірювань
examples.why: "Shots" are circuit repetitions, not measurements; the table column is also the same `shots` option shown in the code blocks, so the mapping to the parameter is obscured.

editor_note: The last third of the file is simply not translated: from `## Available models` (uk line 384) to the end (line 463) every heading and every prose sentence is still English — "These are the latest recommended models for use with Qiskit Code Assistant:", "GGUF format models are optimized for local use and require fewer computational resources:", the italic "*Note: All models listed in the benchmark table were evaluated using their respective system prompt…*", and critically the deprecation caveat "These models are no longer actively maintained but remain available:". A Ukrainian-only reader therefore loses the whole model-selection and deprecation guidance, including the warning not to build on `granite-8b-qiskit-rc-0.10` / `granite-8b-qiskit`; the rest of the page is fully localized, so this is an unfinished translation, not a keep-in-English convention. Second real defect: "Qiskit Advocates" is rendered "адвокатами Qiskit" (line 28), which in Ukrainian means *lawyers/attorneys* — the sentence now claims IBM built the benchmark with Qiskit's legal counsel. Two hard grammatical typos also survive ("обов'язково замін" for "заміни", line 112; "Зберери з вихідного коду" for "Збери", line 213), plus smaller slips: "refer to Mistral AI documentation" → "зверни увагу на документацію" (= "note the documentation" rather than "consult"), "customize the inference" → "налаштувати виведення результатів" (reads as output formatting, not inference), and "Manually deploy…" loses "вручну" in three accordion titles while the later "Ручне підключення…" titles keep it. Register ("ти") is consistently informal and correct throughout the translated portion.

examples.source: ## Available models … These models are no longer actively maintained but remain available:
examples.suggested: Translate the whole tail section: '## Доступні моделі', '#### Поточні моделі', 'Це найновіші моделі, рекомендовані для використання з Qiskit Code Assistant:', '#### Застарілі моделі', 'Ці моделі більше активно не підтримуються, але залишаються доступними:', plus the GGUF lead-in, the '*Примітка: усі моделі…*' table note and the citations lead-in.
examples.translation: ## Available models … These models are no longer actively maintained but remain available:
examples.why: Roughly 80 lines — the entire model-selection reference and the deprecation caveat — were never translated, so the Ukrainian reader gets no localized guidance on which model to pick and no warning that two of the listed models are deprecated.

examples.source: we collaborated with Qiskit Advocates and experts to create the execution-based benchmarks
examples.suggested: ми співпрацювали з учасниками програми Qiskit Advocates та експертами, щоб створити бенчмарки на основі виконання коду
examples.translation: ми співпрацювали з адвокатами та експертами Qiskit для створення бенчмарків на основі виконання коду
examples.why: 'Адвокат' in Ukrainian means a lawyer/attorney; the false friend turns the Qiskit Advocates community program into IBM's legal team, asserting something the source does not say.

examples.source: be sure to update `<PATH-TO-GGUF-FILE>` to the actual path of your downloaded model
examples.suggested: обов'язково заміни `<PATH-TO-GGUF-FILE>` на фактичний шлях до завантаженої моделі
examples.translation: обов'язково замін `<PATH-TO-GGUF-FILE>` на фактичний шлях до завантаженої моделі
examples.why: 'замін' is not a valid verb form — the imperative is 'заміни'; a bare typo in a step-by-step install instruction.

examples.source: Build from source by cloning this repository
examples.suggested: Збери з вихідного коду, клонувавши цей репозиторій
examples.translation: Зберери з вихідного коду, [клонувавши цей репозиторій]
examples.why: 'Зберери' is a nonexistent word (blend of 'збери'/'зберегти'); it stops a native reader mid-sentence in an installation checklist.

examples.source: You can also add text generation parameters to the model to customize the inference
examples.suggested: …щоб налаштувати інференс (процес генерації)
examples.translation: Також можна додати параметри генерації тексту до моделі, щоб налаштувати виведення результатів
examples.why: 'виведення результатів' reads as formatting/printing the output; the source is about tuning inference itself, and the same file already uses 'LLM-виведення' for inference at line 205, so the term is also split within the file.

examples.source: For more information about the Mistral AI models family, refer to Mistral AI documentation.
examples.suggested: Докладніше про сімейство моделей Mistral AI — див. документацію Mistral AI.
examples.translation: Для отримання додаткової інформації про сімейство моделей Mistral AI зверни увагу на документацію Mistral AI.
examples.why: 'зверни увагу на' means 'take note of', not 'consult/refer to'; combined with the calqued 'Для отримання додаткової інформації' opener it reads as machine translation rather than native technical prose.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the tricky conditional logic in "Особливості завантаження збережених облікових даних" (token ignored when name is given; default account loaded only if neither token nor name is provided; last-alphabetical name wins with no default) is rendered correctly, as is the auto-selection order and the "буде нараховано вартість" cost caveat, so nothing here would mislead a learner. What a native technical editor would still change: (1) "If you named one or more sets of credentials" is flattened to "Якщо ти зберіг кілька наборів облікових даних", losing the singular case; (2) "a cost will be incurred" as "буде нараховано вартість" is an unidiomatic calque (нараховують плату/витрати, not вартість); (3) the euphony slip "у активному Python-середовищі" (should be "в активному"); (4) "default" is rendered "за замовчуванням" everywhere except one spot where it becomes "типовий"; (5) the last Next-steps link title is left untranslated ("Run your first circuit on hardware") while every other link title in the same block is translated. Informal "ти" register holds consistently across the file.

examples.source: If you named one or more sets of credentials - for example, for open and premium access - use the following code to use a set of named credentials.
examples.suggested: Якщо ти зберіг один або кілька наборів облікових даних із власними назвами — ...
examples.translation: Якщо ти зберіг кілька наборів облікових даних із власними назвами — наприклад, для відкритого і преміум-доступу — використовуй такий код для завантаження конкретного набору.
examples.why: "one or more" is narrowed to "кілька" (several), so a reader who named exactly one set may think this code path does not apply. Dropped qualifier, not misleading enough to fail.

examples.source: If this instance is not associated with a free plan, a cost will be incurred.
examples.suggested: Якщо цей екземпляр не пов'язаний із безплатним планом, буде стягнено плату (використання буде платним).
examples.translation: Якщо цей екземпляр не пов'язаний із безплатним планом, буде нараховано вартість.
examples.why: "нараховано вартість" is a literal calque of "a cost will be incurred"; Ukrainian charges плату / стягує кошти, вартість is not something one "нараховує".

examples.source: Ensure you are working in an active Python environment with the Qiskit SDK and Qiskit Runtime installed.
examples.suggested: Переконайся, що працюєш в активному Python-середовищі зі встановленими Qiskit SDK і Qiskit Runtime.
examples.translation: Переконайся, що працюєш у активному Python-середовищі зі встановленими Qiskit SDK і Qiskit Runtime.
examples.why: Euphony rule violation: у/в alternation requires "в активному" after a vowel-final word; a native editor fixes this automatically.

examples.source: the user saved accounts named "my_premium" and "my_open" but didn't mark either as the default
examples.suggested: ... але не позначив жоден як обліковий запис за замовчуванням
examples.translation: користувач зберіг акаунти з назвами "my_premium" і "my_open", але не позначив жоден як типовий
examples.why: "default" is rendered "за замовчуванням" everywhere else in the file (канал за замовчуванням, облікові дані за замовчуванням, акаунт за замовчуванням); the lone "типовий" is an in-file inconsistency for the same concept.

examples.source: Follow the steps in the Run your first circuit on hardware guide to write and run a quantum program.
examples.suggested: Виконай кроки з посібника [Запусти свій перший Circuit на обладнанні](/guides/hello-world), ...
examples.translation: Виконай кроки з посібника [Run your first circuit on hardware](/guides/hello-world), щоб написати й запустити квантову програму.
examples.why: Every other link title in the same Recommendations block is translated (Створюй екземпляри та керуй ними, Ініціалізуй сервіс у ненадійному середовищі); leaving this one in English is an inconsistency inside a single list.

editor_note: No misleading drift: the proof chain (existence of purifications, Schmidt construction, unitary equivalence, bit-commitment impossibility, HJW) tracks the English faithfully, and core terms are stable (تنقية = purification, الحالة المختزلة = reduced state, التكافؤ الأحادي للتنقيات, معاملات شميدت, الحالة المخلوطة تماماً). Two terminology slips: the section heading renders "Schmidt decompositions" as "التحليلات الطيفية لشميدت" ("Schmidt SPECTRAL decompositions"), conflating it with التحليل الطيفي — the very thing the body distinguishes at line 131 ("ليس تحليلاً طيفياً") and correctly calls "تحليلات شميدت" everywhere else; and "orthonormal" is dropped to bare "متعامدة" at two places (lines 55, 86) while the file otherwise uses "متعامد وحيدي" consistently — at line 86 that quietly removes the normalization condition from the general purification statement. Remaining nits are stylistic: "يُعطي وضوحاً" as a calque of "clearly yields" (line 485), "البروتوكول الافتراضي المنظور" for "the hypothetical protocol being considered" (line 451), and "مضروباً تنسيرياً" (line 484) for "tensored". Also "e-bit" becomes "كيوبتاً متشابكاً" (a single entangled qubit) rather than a shared unit of entanglement, though the gloss that immediately follows repairs it.

examples.source: ## Schmidt decompositions
examples.suggested: ## تحليلات شميدت
examples.translation: ## التحليلات الطيفية لشميدت
examples.why: Adding "الطيفية" labels the section "Schmidt SPECTRAL decompositions", conflating two concepts the lesson deliberately keeps apart (line 131 says a convex combination "ليس تحليلاً طيفياً"). The body text uses the correct "تحليلات شميدت" throughout, so the heading is also internally inconsistent.

examples.source: More generally, for any orthonormal set of vectors $\{\vert\gamma_0\rangle,\ldots\}$, the quantum state vector ... is a purification of $\rho.$
examples.suggested: لأي مجموعة متعامدة وحيدية من الشعاعات
examples.translation: بصورة أعم، لأي مجموعة متعامدة من الشعاعات $\{\vert\gamma_0\rangle,\ldots\}$، يكون شعاع الحالة الكمية ... تنقيةً لـ $\rho.$
examples.why: "orthonormal" is reduced to "متعامدة" (merely orthogonal), dropping the normalization the claim depends on — a non-unit set does not give a purification. The file itself uses "متعامدة وحيدية" for orthonormal ~10 times (lines 152, 203, 218, 298, 362, 408), so the bare form here reads as a different, weaker condition.

examples.source: $p_0,\ldots,p_{n-1}$ are the eigenvalues of $\rho,$ and $\vert\phi_0\rangle,\ldots$ are orthonormal eigenvectors corresponding to these eigenvalues
examples.suggested: هي القيم الذاتية لـ $\rho,$ ... متجهات ذاتية متعامدة وحيدية مقابلة لهذه القيم الذاتية
examples.translation: و$p_0,\ldots,p_{n-1}$ هي قيم ذاتية لـ $\rho,$ وشعاعات $\vert\phi_0\rangle,\ldots$ هي متجهات ذاتية متعامدة يتوافق كل منها مع قيمته الذاتية
examples.why: Same orthonormal→orthogonal slip, plus "the eigenvalues" is indefinitised to "قيم ذاتية" (some eigenvalues), softening the spectral-theorem statement that these ARE the full eigenvalue list.

examples.source: because a standard basis measurement performed on $\mathsf{Z}$ clearly yields each outcome $a$ with probability $p_a$
examples.suggested: لأن من الواضح أن قياس الأساس القياسي على $\mathsf{Z}$ يُعطي كل نتيجة $a$ باحتمالية $p_a$
examples.translation: لأن قياس الأساس القياسي على $\mathsf{Z}$ يُعطي وضوحاً كل نتيجة $a$ باحتمالية $p_a$
examples.why: "يُعطي وضوحاً" is a word-order calque of the English adverb and reads as "gives clarity"; no Arabic technical writer would place "clearly" as an accusative here.

examples.source: and so the hypothetical protocol being considered completely fails to be binding
examples.suggested: ومن ثمَّ يفشل البروتوكول الافتراضي قيد النظر فشلاً تاماً في أن يكون مُلزِماً
examples.translation: ومن ثمَّ يفشل البروتوكول الافتراضي المنظور كلياً في أن يكون مُلزِماً
examples.why: "المنظور" is not idiomatic for "being considered" (the standard collocation is "قيد النظر"), and the sentence reads stiffly in a passage that is otherwise fluent.

editor_note: No misleading content: the physics narrative is faithful throughout, including the delicate §4 paragraph (transversal field → almost-certain spin swap; longitudinal α=±90° → no evolution; α=±45° → all combinations, swap most likely at 67%) and the Trotter accuracy trade-off ("كلما صغرت الخطوة الزمنية، كان التقريب أدق … دوائر أعمق … تراكماً أكبر للأخطاء"). What a native technical editor would still change is terminology consistency and a few clunky constructions: "spin" is rendered "الدوران/الدورانات" in §1–2.5 but "الأسبين/أسبينات" in §4; "transverse field" is "المجال المستعرض" in the title/§2.1 but "حقل عرضي" in §4; "order" alternates between "الرتبة" and "الدرجة" in the same sentence-pair (§2.4, §3); and "quantum hardware" switches to "العتاد الكمي" while the rest of the file uses "الكمومي". Two sentences are syntactically garbled though still decodable — "يُعدّ تعبير الهاميلتونيات المعقدة بشكل بوابات كمومية تحدياً" (needs "التعبير عن … بواسطة") and "تتكون الصيغة من الدرجة الأولى من التقريب المذكور في المقدمة" — and "even now using the simulator" became "حتى الآن باستخدام المحاكي" ("so far"), flattening the intended "even at this stage". None of these would give a learner a false belief.

examples.source: These lattices consist of an array of spins … a spin swap
examples.suggested: pick one rendering for "spin" (e.g. "سبين/أسبين") and use it in §1 and §4 alike
examples.translation: تتكون هذه الشبكات من مصفوفة من الدورانات … تبادل للأسبين
examples.why: The same physical concept is named "الدوران" in the introduction and "الأسبين" in the hardware section; a reader who learned the first term must re-map it halfway through the lesson.

examples.source: transverse field / transversal field
examples.suggested: تحت تأثير مجال مستعرض
examples.translation: هاميلتوني إيزينج ذي المجال المستعرض … تحت تأثير حقل عرضي
examples.why: The defining term of the whole model shifts from "المجال المستعرض" (title, §2.1) to "حقل عرضي" (§4), and "field" itself alternates between مجال and حقل within the same paragraph.

examples.source: Thus, expressing complicated Hamiltonians in quantum gates is a challenge.
examples.suggested: لذا، فإن التعبير عن الهاميلتونيات المعقدة بواسطة بوابات كمومية يمثل تحدياً.
examples.translation: لذا، يُعدّ تعبير الهاميلتونيات المعقدة بشكل بوابات كمومية تحدياً قائماً.
examples.why: "تعبير … بشكل" is ungrammatical Arabic (the verbal noun requires "التعبير عن", and "بشكل" is a calque of "in"); a native technical writer would never phrase it this way.

examples.source: A first-order formula consists of the approximation stated in the introduction, where the matrix exponential of a sum is approximated by a product of matrix exponentials
examples.suggested: تتكون صيغة الرتبة الأولى من التقريب المذكور في المقدمة، حيث يُقرَّب أسّي مصفوفة المجموع بجداء أسّيات المصفوفات
examples.translation: تتكون الصيغة من الدرجة الأولى من التقريب المذكور في المقدمة، حيث يُقرَّب الأسّي للمصفوفة لمجموع بجداء من الأسسيات للمصفوفات
examples.why: The word order makes "من الدرجة الأولى" attach to the verb rather than to "الصيغة", so the sentence first parses as "the formula consists, of first degree, of the approximation…"; the second clause piles up three genitives and reads as raw MT.

examples.source: But let us get in the habit of counting the operations for this circuit, even now using the simulator.
examples.suggested: … حتى في هذه المرحلة التي نستخدم فيها المحاكي.
examples.translation: لكن دعنا نتعوّد على إحصاء العمليات في هذه الدائرة، حتى الآن باستخدام المحاكي.
examples.why: "حتى الآن" reads as "so far/until now", losing the concessive "even now" (i.e. even while we are still on a simulator); the pedagogical point — start the habit early — is blunted.

examples.source: As a real time evolution technique, Trotterization consists in …
examples.suggested: تقنية للتطور في الزمن الحقيقي
examples.translation: التروترة (Trotterization) هي تقنية لمحاكاة التطور الزمني الآني
examples.why: "الآني" means instantaneous/live, whereas "real time" here is the physics contrast with imaginary-time evolution; recognizable in context but not the conventional domain rendering.

examples.source: Construct the histogram of the bitstrings
examples.suggested: ابنِ المدرج التكراري لسلاسل البتات
examples.translation: ابنِ مخطط الرسم البياني لـ bitstrings
examples.why: "مخطط الرسم البياني" is a vague tautology ("the chart of the graph") instead of the standard "المدرج التكراري" for histogram.

editor_note: The forward-reference that opens "Error reduction for random errors" mistranslates the load-bearing contrast of the lesson: EN "the last section of the lesson, which concerns **arbitrary** quantum errors" is rendered "القسم الأخير من الدرس المتعلق بالأخطاء الكمومية **العشوائية**", i.e. "random" — the very same word ("بشكل عشوائي") the same sentence then uses for the random Pauli model of THIS section.
